items.question: What additional gift is bestowed after bringing wealth from Vaiśravaṇa's house?
premises: An additional item is involved, indicated by anyat+ca.
Wealth is brought from the house of Vaiśravaṇa.
The brought wealth is then given.
items.inference: Beyond the previously mentioned gifts, wealth obtained from Vaiśravaṇa's house is also bestowed.
uncertainties: The recipient of the gift is not explicitly named in this verse.
items.plain_english: And having brought other wealth from the house of Vaiśravaṇa, he gives it.
